The proof applies the proved one-half free-mode lower bound to the opposite-parity component in that SAME actual range. ALL complex associated vectors and coincident roots are included.

Original Fourier parity is transferred to the ACTUAL continuous H1 representative at EVERY real point: f(x+1)=wave(n,1)*f(x), with phase of norm EXACTLY ONE. Therefore the original normalized periodic physical L2 norm squared is EXACTLY the UNNORMALIZED unit-interval integral of norm(f)^2. No factor two, changed physical period or replacement norm is introduced.

Every finite-dimensional complex space of dimension above ONE has an ACTUAL norm-one vector in the kernel of EVERY bounded scalar functional. Applying this to the ORIGINAL actual rank-two spectral range and its ACTUAL native continuous evaluation at zero produces a full original H1 spectral vector of actual physical L2 norm ONE with trace ZERO, without a supplied trace-zero witness or basis.

EVERY original H1 vector with zero physical values at zero and one has a UNIQUE representative in the ENTIRE ORIGINAL native Dirichlet H1 domain, agreeing at EVERY point of the closed physical interval. If it has either original Fourier parity and trace zero at zero, trace zero at one follows and the Dirichlet restriction has EXACTLY the SAME physical L2 norm as its original periodic source vector.

ONE original endpoint norm-ball cutoff above ANY supplied earlier cutoff now constructs the ACTUAL high periodic spectral boundary-zero H1 vector G and its faithful native interval vector g for EVERY original complex physically period-one source and ALL later ORIGINAL n. Both physical L2 norms are EXACTLY ONE; BOTH endpoint values vanish; the physical translation phase is EXACTLY wave(n,1); the interval representatives coincide on ALL of [0,1]; G has an IDENTICAL ENTIRE original F-ell^(s+2,infinity) distribution.

The exact ORIGINAL native eta residual of EVERY linear combination G=alpha*f+beta*phi is PROVED to be (beta*eta)*Jf-(beta*gamma)*Jphi. Thus beta is required on BOTH residual terms. This formally verifies the native precursor of the coefficient correction needed in printed source (31); the full interval restriction/operator/projected identity is NOT yet proved.
